# Project Documentation Notes

## Structure

This is a Claude Code plugin (`documentation-review`) — the markdown files serve dual purposes:

| Directory | Purpose | Audience |
|-----------|---------|----------|
| `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` | Project documentation | Plugin users |
| `commands/*.md` | Slash command definitions | Claude Code runtime |
| `agents/*.md` | Agent specifications | Claude Code runtime |
| `skills/*/SKILL.md` | Domain knowledge modules | Claude Code runtime |
| `skills/*/examples/` | Example documents | Plugin users (reference) |
| `skills/*/references/` | Detailed reference material | Claude Code runtime |
| `templates/` | Configuration templates | Plugin users |
| `.github/` | GitHub templates | Contributors |

## Review Focus Areas

- **README.md**: Accurate feature list, installation instructions, usage examples
- **docs/**.md**: Clear explanations, up-to-date information, consistent formatting
- **CHANGELOG.md**: Follows Keep a Changelog format, entries are user-focused
- **Skills**: Comprehensive domain coverage, accurate examples, working code blocks
- **Commands**: Clear argument hints, consistent structure, correct tool allowlists
- **Agents**: Accurate descriptions, appropriate tool lists, consistent patterns
- **Templates**: Valid YAML frontmatter, sensible defaults, clear comments

## Conventions

- All commands use `doc-` prefix for naming consistency
- Skills use `SKILL.md` as the main file with `examples/` and `references/` subdirectories
- Frontmatter YAML schemas vary by file type (commands vs agents vs skills)
